question: Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.

WITH match_runs AS (
    SELECT m.match_id, 
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_batsman_runs
    FROM match m
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON m.match_id = bs.match_id
    GROUP BY m.match_id
),
match_extra_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, SUM(extra_runs) as total_extra_runs
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
match_total_runs AS (
    SELECT mr.match_id, 
           mr.total_batsman_runs + COALESCE(er.total_extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM match_runs mr
    LEFT JOIN match_extra_runs er ON mr.match_id = er.match_id
),
match_players_count AS (
    SELECT match_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as num_players
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY match_id
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, pm.match_id, 
           mtr.total_runs / mpc.num_players as runs_attributed
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN match_total_runs mtr ON pm.match_id = mtr.match_id
    JOIN match_players_count mpc ON pm.match_id = mpc.match_id
),
player_stats AS (
    SELECT player_id, 
           SUM(runs_attributed) as total_runs,
           COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as matches_played,
           SUM(runs_attributed) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT country_name, AVG(avg_runs_per_match) as country_avg_player_avg
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN player p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY country_avg_player_avg DESC
LIMIT 5
